hero.subhead: Breakfasts, sourdough toasties and cakes baked here each morning, by the canal in Hebden Bridge.

items.description: Our cakes are baked fresh on site every morning, ready for you by the canal.
A hearty breakfast by the water, simple food cooked with care.
Made to order with good bread and simple fillings, a canalside favourite.

services.heading: Breakfasts, toasties and cakes baked here each morning.

about.statement: We wanted a café on the canal where everyone feels welcome, muddy boots, dogs and prams included.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: We're an independent café on the canal in Hebden Bridge. Just follow the towpath and look out for our door.

items.question: Can I bring my dog?
items.answer: Yes, dogs are welcome here at our canalside café. Prams and muddy boots are very welcome too.

items.question: Do you bake on site?
items.answer: Yes, our cakes are baked here each morning. Come and see what's just come out of the oven.

items.question: What food do you serve?
items.answer: We serve breakfasts, sourdough toasties and cakes baked each morning, all by the canal.

items.question: Are sourdough toasties made fresh?
items.answer: Our sourdough toasties are made to order, using good bread and simple fillings.

footer.tagline: Canalside coffee and cake for all
